title: EEG-Speech Brain Decoding Dataset
description: An EEG dataset paired with audio recordings for decoding speech from brain activity. It includes overt speech production, auditory listening, and listening followed by covert speech imagery tasks. Data were acquired with three EEG systems (g.tec g.Pangolin, g.tec g.SCARABEO, and ANT Neuro eego sports), together with EOG, EMG, and audio monitor channels.
methods_description: EEG was recorded with g.tec g.Pangolin (128 channels), g.tec g.SCARABEO (64 channels), or ANT Neuro eego sports (64 channels), along with audio monitor, EOG, lip EMG, and trigger channels. Participants completed overt speech production (vocalizing visually presented text), listening to prerecorded speech, and listening followed by covert speech imagery. Sessions are organized by recording date and stored in EDF format with synchronized WAV audio. 3D electrode coordinates from digitization are provided for g.Pangolin sessions.
